help.title: Help
help.description: Answers to the most common questions about accounts, playback and languages.
help.devicesBody: LuminaFlix runs in any modern browser — and you can install it like an app from the browser menu.

devices.title: Computer
devices.body: Chrome, Edge, Firefox or Safari, on Windows, macOS or Linux.

devices.title: Phone & tablet
devices.body: Safari on iOS/iPadOS and Chrome on Android. Rotate your device for fullscreen playback.

devices.title: TV
devices.body: Cast a browser tab from Chrome, or open the site in your TV's built-in browser.

items.q: Do I need an account to watch?
items.a: No. You can browse and watch without an account. Signing in lets you save favorites, like titles and download.

items.q: How do I delete my account?
items.a: Open your profile menu, choose “Manage account”, then “Delete account”. Your favorites are removed with it.

items.q: The video won't start or keeps buffering.
items.a: Streams come from several servers. Switch to another server below the player; if none work, reload the page.
Some browser extensions (ad blockers, download managers) prevent the player from loading. Disable them for this site and reload.

items.q: How do I change the language?
items.a: Use the language menu in the navigation bar or the footer. Your choice is remembered on this device.

items.q: Does the language change titles and summaries?
items.a: Yes. Titles, summaries and genres switch to the selected language when a translation exists.

help.stillNeedHelpBody: Send us a message and we'll get back to you by email.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.intro: This policy explains what information LuminaFlix collects, why, and the choices you have.

sections.title: Information we collect
sections.body: When you create an account, our authentication provider (Clerk) stores your name, email address and profile picture. We store the titles you add to favorites and your likes. When you use the contact form we receive your name, email and message.

sections.title: How we use it
sections.body: We use this information to run your account, sync your favorites, reply to your messages and send occasional recommendation emails. We don't sell your personal information.

sections.title: Cookies and local storage
sections.body: We use essential cookies for sign-in and to remember your language. Analytics (Vercel Analytics) measure page views without cross-site tracking.

sections.title: Third-party services
sections.body: Movie and series information comes from TMDB. Video players are provided by third-party services that have their own privacy policies and may set their own cookies. Visitors from outside Madagascar are checked once with Google reCAPTCHA, which is subject to Google's Privacy Policy and Terms. To spot VPNs and proxies in our audience statistics, visitor IP addresses are checked with proxycheck.io.

sections.title: Your rights
sections.body: You can access, correct or delete your data at any time from your account settings, or by contacting us. If you live in the EU, you may also lodge a complaint with your data protection authority.

sections.title: Retention
sections.body: We keep your data while your account is active. Deleting your account removes your profile and favorites within 30 days.

terms.title: Terms of
terms.intro: By using LuminaFlix you agree to these terms. Please read them carefully.

sections.title: The service
sections.body: LuminaFlix is a catalog that displays information from TMDB and embeds players operated by third parties. We don't host video files and don't control the content provided by these services.

sections.title: Your account
sections.body: You're responsible for activity on your account and for keeping your sign-in details secure. You must be old enough to consent to data processing in your country.

sections.title: Acceptable use
sections.body: Don't attempt to disrupt the service, scrape it at scale, or use it for unlawful purposes. We may suspend accounts that do.

sections.title: Rights holders
sections.body: If you believe content accessible through LuminaFlix infringes your rights, contact us with the details and we'll review your request promptly.

sections.title: Disclaimer
sections.body: The service is provided “as is”, without warranties of availability or fitness for a particular purpose, to the extent permitted by law.

sections.title: Changes
sections.body: We may update these terms. When we do, we'll change the date at the top of this page. Continuing to use the service means you accept the updated terms.
